questions.text: Quick Revision - Conventional and Alternative Sources of Energy

definitionBean.title: Conventional and Solar Energy Sources
definitionBean.definition: Energy sources that have been in use for a long time (such as coal, petroleum, fossil fuels) are called conventional sources; and energy obtained from the sun is called 'solar energy'[cite: 38].
definitionBean.explanation: Fossil fuels are non-renewable and their burning causes air pollution. In contrast, solar energy, wind energy, and biogas are renewable and eco-friendly sources[cite: 38].
importantPoints: Fossil fuels: Coal and petroleum (exhaustible resources)[cite: 38]
Solar energy: Electricity generation through solar cookers and solar cells[cite: 38]
Biogas: Anaerobic decomposition of animal dung and plant residues[cite: 38]
Nuclear energy: Obtaining immense energy through nuclear fission or fusion[cite: 38]

questions.text: Subject: Sources of Energy and Solar Energy

parts.statement: What should be the characteristics of a good source of energy[cite: 38]?
parts.correct_answer: A good energy source should provide adequate energy, be easily accessible, safe, and economical[cite: 38].
parts.explanation: Characteristics of a good source of energy: 1. It should deliver a high amount of work (energy) per unit mass or volume[cite: 38]. 2. It should be easily accessible[cite: 38]. 3. It should be safe in transport and storage[cite: 38]. 4. It should be economical (cheap)[cite: 38]. 5. It should cause minimum environmental pollution[cite: 38].

parts.statement: What is the impact of burning fossil fuels on the environment? Write two advantages of biogas[cite: 38].
parts.correct_answer: Fossil fuels cause air pollution and global warming; biogas is smoke-free and yields good manure[cite: 38].
parts.explanation: Burning fossil fuels (coal, petroleum) releases harmful gases like carbon dioxide and sulfur, which cause air pollution, global warming, and acid rain[cite: 38]. Advantages of biogas: It is smoke-free and yields high-quality manure[cite: 38].
